hand.name: Fang-Adder
hand.text: POISON. If a character is damaged by this character, exhaust that character and place a Poison counter on it. At the beginning of each player's turn, for each Poisoned character they control, that player rolls a die. Otherwise, that character remains exhausted this turn and its controller takes 1 damage for each Poison counter on it.
